verdict.rationale: Base44's own quick-start docs say a Figma frame can be turned into a working app. The docs also cover starting from a website you already own, and sharing a public site link so the chat copies its design, layout and visible content. These are first-party claims for the core story, but the Figma import is a one-line mention with no documented workflow or depth. missing for 10: detailed docs on Figma file import (whole files vs. single frames, auth/plugin method, fidelity of components and styles), support for other design-file formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration that imported designs are implemented faithfully.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it

citations.quote: Turn a Figma frame into a working app.
Begin from a website you already own and refine it in the app editor.
Share a public website link with the chat to instantly copy the design, layout, and visible content into your app.
